answer: The knoll register is checked at draw time, nebula lists the eligible set, and dune seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 56 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time a hostile operator burns for every seat it wants. Jury seats open only to identities older than 56 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh farm has no way to grade its own output. Bonded capital sits idle for 19 days. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
